label: last one or two copy-phase steps (end of copy)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.9% of mass), at the last or second-to-last output (to_go 0: 73% of mass; to_go 0-1: 92%), and only at recall_idx >= 2-3. It is strongest for short sequences: L=4 at its final step t=7 holds about half the mass, and the top activations are all L=4 final steps. Within that window it is sparse (about 8% of steps) and depends on the token: it favors outputs o, z, 3, k, m, p, r and inputs that repeat an earlier token (in_first=0). No token-set or L condition got dev F1 above about 0.33. It does not fire in the original phase, on the delimiter, or in early copy steps.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=9: 3, o, z, g; t=17: z, g, t, 3; t=15: z, 3, g, o) and the token being output (most: o, z, 3, k, m, p; least: d, c, s, y); timing cues that raise it most: L=4 & t=7, to_go=0, recall_idx=4.
